comparison.objective: Clamp a pan and plate together, invert them, release the cake, and remove the pan; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Cake task tests large-object bimanual clamping, coordinated inversion, containment, regrasping, and separation; candidate tests small-tool insertion, setscrew manipulation, fine adjustment, bounded torque, and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Cake must end inverted and centered on a plate on the stand with the pan separated, all still; candidate must meet quantitative energy, velocity, stroke, rebound, overload, and drift conditions across two cycles.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual, but their tested abilities and failure modes are unrelated. Missing rubric details: cake breakage and sticking are not modeled, yet no plausible duplicate remains.
